name: reading-comprehension
description: Strategies for constructing meaning from text, monitoring understanding, and repairing comprehension breakdowns. Covers before-during-after reading framework, seven evidence-based comprehension strategies (activating prior knowledge, questioning, visualizing, inferring, determining importance, summarizing, monitoring/fix-up), text structure recognition (narrative and expository), schema theory, close reading protocols, and the gradual release of responsibility instructional model. Use when teaching comprehension strategies, analyzing reader difficulties, planning text-based instruction, or building meaning from complex texts.
